_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::particles#7, confirmed and made concrete. Upstream particle_sph_2d_pdbody_gravity.4C.yaml has 444 boundaryphase wall particles and 162 pdphase body particles under PHASE_TO_MATERIAL_ID 'boundaryphase 1 pdphase 2'. Exchanging just the two TYPE labels makes the wall the peridynamic body — the bond list grows from 1512 to 3588 pairs — while the former body becomes a boundary phase and stops moving entirely: after 3000 steps its probe particle sits at posx 6.50000000000000000e+00 with velx and vely exactly 0.00000000000000000e+00, which is the entry's 'sticks to it, no rebound' in numbers. The only complaint 4C makes is "state 'pd_damage_phi' not found in container!" from particle/src/algorithm/4C_particle_algorithm_result_test.cpp line 194, because the probed particle no longer carries peridynamic states. That message names a state and never a phase, a TYPE or PHASE_TO_MATERIAL_ID, so it sends an agent hunting for a broken output request instead of a swapped label. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.
expect_in_output: Number of initialized peridynamic bonds on this proc: 1512
Number of initialized peridynamic bonds on this proc: 3588

_mutation.note: remove the pathology: write the deck back with its original TYPE labels instead of exchanging them. The second arm then reproduces the baseline, PD_PARTICLES_SWAP falls back to 162, the 3588-bond line and the pd_damage_phi complaint disappear and EXIT_SWAP becomes 0, so the fixture must go red.
